interface.selection: --phase-policy POLICY on start AND resume; bound at admission (a resume under another policy is refused R2); omitted = all-or-nothing/1
interface.admission: retain-guaranteed-fees/1 refuses a Fee after a fallible effect in the same segment (exit 1, no status, stage admit)
interface.rejected_fin: committed{snapshot,effects,logical_work} is the retained prefix (plus the sealed fee phase under retain-guaranteed-fees/1); retained_by_policy.effects are those fees; discarded_tentative.effects the discarded delta; ledger_rollback none-inferred
interface.evaluator_note: Adopted from sherlock-u2's draft. The holdout consumes only phase_policy.retain-guaranteed-fees/1 (appended to start AND resume). Admission refusal of a Fee after a fallible effect is asserted only as a nonzero exit without a waiting/halted status; whether it is refused at program admission or at segment entry (note section 16: R2, exit 4) is not asserted, and the holdout fixtures keep every unreached segment fees-first so either reading gives the same verdict.
